Delicious spring rolls
Jul 2023 • Friends
This restaurant is located at 65 Hang Trong Hoan Kiem, The restaurant has quite a lot of different delicious dishes, in which the one I highly recommend is probably the shrimp spring roll. Shrimp meat is very fragrant and sweet. The dipping sauce used for the spring rolls is quite good I think this is the restaurant's own recipe. The vegetables come with a lot, if you run out, you can ask for more from the staff. The service staff is very good, the speed is fast, the view of the restaurant is quite beautiful.

Great place for good food in Hanoi
Jun 2019 • Family

The restaurant offered great Hu Tieu soup - we had the seafood variants as the beef pho was sold out. They also had dim sums and rice on offer - the kids seemed to enjoy themselves. All in all a great place to recommend to family travelling in Hanoi.

Adelaide, Australia245 contributions

Good soup, terrible juice
Apr 2019 • Solo
I came to this restaurant because of TripAdvisor reviews, ended up getting the Hu Tieu Tom (prawn soup with rice noodles), soup was tasty and came with a big side of greens, price 60.000, I'd say reasonably priced for the quality, despite the fact that there were only 2 prawns, it's more like a pork soup garnished with prawns.
I had a juice as well (first time having a juice instead of a beer), got utterly regretted, 40.000 for a watermelon juice (probably one of the cheapest fruits available here, as it's normally served on breakfast buffets in hotels), but it was watery, served in a small glass, 4 sips and it was gone. Small beer can be ordered for 25.000.
Place looks clean (one of the best looking budget restaurants I've been to so far) and first time I see chefs wearing chefs attire, also it has AC, much needed to cool you down after a bowl of soup 😊.
